interpretation_override.deterministic_task_completion: Under the audited deterministic evaluation, mean_success_rate is primarily the fraction of trained policies/seeds completing the task, not within-policy stochastic reliability.

unit_of_analysis.rule: trained policy/seed is the inferential unit; 200 deterministic episodes are repeated executions
unit_of_analysis.cross_strength_dependence: same held-out seeds and common clean comparator are reused across strengths

uncertainty.status: aggregate JSON supports descriptive point estimates; exact seed-level AUC uncertainty requires retained CI evidence or provenance-preserving deterministic regeneration

visual_restrictions: Do not treat 200 deterministic episodes as independent samples.
Do not claim statistical equivalence to chance from AUC point estimates alone.
Do not present high-strength discrimination as early detection when task completion has already degraded substantially.
Do not generalize failure of this detector into universal subtle-poisoning impossibility.
